SEST LOADING SCREENS - photo credits

The game's 80 loading-screen backgrounds (ui/backgrounds/loading_screen_N.png) are
replaced in turn by these 29 photographs: slot N shows photograph
((N - 1) mod 29) + 1. Real photographs only; no AI imagery. Use does not imply
endorsement by the photographers or any armed service.

sest_loading_01  Combined Space Operations Center (CSpOC) staff monitor workstations (9237933)
  Creator: U.S. Space Force S4S by David Dozoretz
  Licence: Public domain
  Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Combined_Space_Operations_Center_(CSpOC)_staff_monitor_workstations_(9237933).jpg
  Changes: 16:9 crop and resize to 1920x1080 (integration/media-pack/build_media.py); JPEG.
